name: AfriDebug
description: AfriDigital software investigation agent for structured repository and runtime root-cause analysis.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: AfriDigital HMAC authentication using x-afri-agent-id, x-afri-timestamp, x-afri-nonce and x-afri-signature headers.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: x-afri-signature

skills.name: AfriDebug Investigation & Root-Cause Analysis
skills.description: Submit a software or runtime problem to AfriDebug for structured investigation and root-cause analysis. Supports remote repository context, investigation objectives, categories, constraints and agent-to-agent handoff context.
examples: Investigate why my API endpoint is returning HTTP 500.
Find the likely root cause of this runtime failure in my repository.
Analyze this software incident and produce structured investigation findings.

objective.description: The software or runtime problem to investigate.

category.description: Investigation category supplied by the requesting agent.

constraints.description: Constraints that should guide the investigation.

type.description: Repository source type, normally remote for A2A requests.

handoffId.description: Optional identifier linking the investigation to an upstream agent workflow.

investigation.description: Structured investigation result containing investigation state, events and diagnostic artifacts.
